messages:
maria: Quick sync — BluePeak co-marketing package is ready for final review. Need logo lockup, case study quote permission, marketplace tile (1024x512), and approved alt text. Links: Figma: https://figma.com/file/bluepeak/redwood-co-marketing  Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/bluepeak-assets. Deadline: EOD Fri. cc @jason @eli @sam

jason: Uploading SVGs to the Figma file now. Noticed partner used a stacked lockup that's too tight. Can we require 24px clearspace on all versions? I pushed a suggested artboard with fixes.

brandbot: brandbot: Automated check -> logo color contrast ✅, brand palette OK ✅, missing alt text ❌, low-res PNG detected ❌ (found 512x256). See /checks/1912345678

sam: Case study — BluePeak gave us one quote but it's unsourced. @eli do we have a signed release? They said "happy for public quote" on the call but we need explicit sign-off.

eli: Legal: Need BluePeak to sign the partner PR & quote release. Also flagged a competitor callout in the case study — we must remove comparative statements. I'll redline and send them the template for signature.

jason: Design note: Marketplace tile requires 72 DPI and <120KB. I'll export 1024x512 @72dpi and run optimization. For web hero we should stick with SVG and provide 2x PNG for compatibility.

maria: On logos: BluePeak supplied a secondary blue that's very close to our orange in some renditions which impacts contrast. @jason can you try a darker accent or add a subtle outline to the partner mark on co-branded tiles? Otherwise co-branding might fail WCAG checks.

jason: Yep — I can add a 2px white stroke on the partner mark and upload both stroked and unstroked variants. Putting them in /figma/bluepeak/variants now.

sam: Also need attribution format for the quote: prefer 'BluePeak (CPO)' + month/year. If they won't provide a title we'll use company-only attribution.

brandbot: brandbot: New asset scan shows updated variants at /figma/bluepeak/variants. Missing signed quote release: action_required.

maria: I'll ping their CSM to get sign-off and a title for the quote. If no title by Thu, we publish with 'BluePeak Systems' only.

eli: Redlines done: removed competitor comparisons, changed superlative language ("best-in-class") to observed phrasing. Once signed I'm good for marketing publish.

sam: Great. @jason can you also add suggested alt text for each exported image? Example: 'Co-branded Redwood and BluePeak logos on white background. Alt: BluePeak Systems and Redwood Inference logos side by side.'

jason: Done — added alt text in Figma notes and left a small metadata snippet for marketplace JSON: 
```
{
  "title": "Redwood x BluePeak: Low-latency inferencing",
  "description": "Joint solution brief: reducing inference cost by up to 3x for streaming workloads",
  "image": "/assets/bluepeak-marketplace-tile.png"
}
```

sam: Heads-up: that "3x" stat needs sourcing or change to "up to 3x" per Eli. Marketing needs either partner approval or a reference to our benchmark. @maria can you confirm?

maria: We have an internal benchmark doc but will need partner confirmation. Action items: maria -> request confirmation and title; jason -> upload final tiles and alt text; eli -> prep sign docs; sam -> draft marketplace copy with "up to" phrasing until confirmed.

brandbot: brandbot: Marking thread status: pending_partner_signoff :hourglass_flowing_sand:

lee: Sales note: If PR goes live next week, schedule the marketplace publish for Monday so AMs have a stable link for decks. Also please send a short heads-up brief to the AMs once published.

maria: Thanks — will align dates once partner sign-off arrives. I'll update this thread with the final asset links and the signed release.

sam: :thumbsup:
